Asha: Heads-up—Nimbus pilot blocked: their on-prem Rust connector drops tool-call frames over SSE. They need a short patch + a single-page hosted vs 12mo Dedicated comparison for procurement.
Diego: Quick workaround: deploy our translator in their DMZ to convert function-call frames -> local webhook POSTs. No SDK change.
Diego: Config example:
```
translator:
  listen: 0.0.0.0:443
  mode: sse
  forward: webhook
  webhook_url: http://127.0.0.1:8080/tool
```
Rory: I can prepare the one-pager with assumptions (model, avg tokens, cache hit-rate) and a hosted vs Dedicated sketch.
Asha: Security bullets they asked for: KMS integration, SAML SSO, audit log forwarding, cert pinning. Can someone pull together a two-column checklist?
Diego: I'll extract the KMS + SSO snippets and include an ops checklist.
ops-bot: Ticket NP-704 created for translator deploy and handoff (assignee: Diego).
Asha: Plan: Diego = translator + sample webhook repo, Rory = pricing one-pager, Diego to send security checklist. I will consolidate and send Nimbus the package by EOD. :thumbsup:
